No rule found on outside or rental motorcycles at Gulmarg, Pahalgam or Sonamarg; local transport union restrictions are often mentioned by travellers but no source was found.
The Jammu and Kashmir Traffic Police website was opened but showed no dated advisory; advisories were read on news sites.
No permit is known to be needed for these places, but no official statement of that was found.
The Gulmarg chain order does not say how it applies to motorcycles.

No official source found for the rule on prepaid mobile connections.
The first video gives no filming date; it was published on 13 June 2026.
